title: Introductory Arabic
prerequisites_raw: All students who are enrolling in an ARA language course for the FIRST time are required to complete a language assessment questionnaire. Please visit https://www.utm.utoronto.ca/language-studies/language-course-assessment…
exclusions_raw: ARA211H5 or ARA211Y5 or ( LGGA40H3 and LGGA41H3 ) or ( NMC210Y1 or NML210Y1 ) or higher, native speakers.
